purpose: Construct explicit synthetic datasets matching every requested Table 1 count and execute separate measured experiments.
data_identity: SC-Auto-Synthetic, SC-Semi-Synthetic, SC-Energy-Synthetic; not recovered original SC data.

changes.description: Fixed-count typed supply graphs, original synthetic documents and linked signals, independent stochastic cascade labels and train-ready NPZ. Generation settings and limitations recorded in metadata.
Project nodes once per relation instead of materializing the same H-by-H relation matrix per edge. Forward and parameter/input gradients are tested against the original expression.
Reuse one adjacency per query day across path sources without changing candidate ranking or the evaluation definition.
Record configuration digest, epoch timing and CUDA peak memory in new runs. Existing temporal validation and checkpoint/threshold selection rules remain the experiment protocol.
Allow a fixed number of concurrent worker processes per GPU via an explicit CLI option.
Independent raw-record/data audits and separate experiment artifact/metric verification for the new dataset version.

historical_results_policy: Never relabel or aggregate v1.0.0 SIM/ICKG results as full-scale SC-Synthetic runs. The earlier frozen training source and historical Release remain available.
